abort.channels_detected: The device responded, and its settings are saved.
abort.not_supported: This is not a supported Smart Matic device

error.invalid_device: This is not a supported Smart Matic device
error.no_reply: The device didn't respond. Move it closer to a Bluetooth adapter or proxy, disconnect any phone connected to it, and try again.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up {name}
bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up the Smart Matic at {address}? Home Assistant will connect to it to check that it responds.

reconfigure.title: Check the connection
reconfigure.description: Connect to the device again and check how it communicates, for example after a firmware update.

progress.probing_again: Setting the clock and trying connection option {index} of {total} again…

update_status.name: Update status
update_status.description: Connects to the device and refreshes its status and schedules. Bypasses the automatic retry cooldown. If no target is given, every configured device is updated.

set_schedules.name: Set schedules
set_schedules.description: Replaces all of the device's own spray schedules (up to 10). Each needs days, start, end and interval (10, 20 or 40 minutes). The device keeps running them without Home Assistant.

schedules.name: Schedules
schedules.description: List of schedules, each with days (mon to sun, or daily), start and end (HH:MM; an end at or before the start is the next day, up to 24 hours) and interval.

expected.name: Expected
expected.description: Optional: the list this edit started from, as the Schedules sensor shows it. If the device's list differs, nothing is written.

add_schedule.name: Add schedule
add_schedule.description: Adds one schedule to the device's own schedules.

end.name: End
end.description: End of the window. An end at or before the start means the next day (up to 24 hours). Rounded down to a whole interval.

remove_schedule.name: Remove schedule
remove_schedule.description: Removes one of the device's schedules, by its number in the Schedules sensor's list.

clear_schedules.name: Clear schedules
clear_schedules.description: Removes all of the device's own schedules.

stop_schedule.name: Skip schedule run
stop_schedule.description: Skips a running schedule, device acknowledges but ignores it if the number is not the current running schedule.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: current (the one running now), all, or a number from the Schedules sensor's list.

command_not_confirmed.message: The air freshener didn't confirm the command. Check that it's in range and try again.

cannot_reach.message: Couldn't reach the air freshener. Check that it's switched on and in range, and try again.

battery_too_low.message: Batteries are too low to spray. Replace them.

auto_running.message: Auto mode is running. Stop it to use Identify.

schedule_running.message: A schedule is running. Skip it or wait for it to end to use Identify.

schedules_changed.message: The schedules on the device changed since they were read. Read them again before saving.

auto_during_schedule.message: A schedule is running. Skip it to stop it.

schedules_not_stored.message: The device didn't store all the schedules. Check them with Update status.

no_devices_matched.message: No loaded Smart Matic devices match the target.
